    Adjoint module truncations for object deletion #

    For a set S of deleted objects, ambient modules vanishing on S form the essential image of extension by zero. This file constructs the two adjoints to their inclusion. The right adjoint takes the largest submodule vanishing on S; the left adjoint takes the largest quotient vanishing on S.
